body:
> **RE-DERIVED [2026-09-04] against the full 582-message thread.** This page was
> written from the 228 received messages alone and stated that Dan's half
> "survives nowhere in it". It survives in
> `raw/self/dox-scan/all_imessages_complete_dump.txt`, which the page did not
> read, and it is the demand side of a supply relationship — so the missing half
> was the half the page most needed. The count was corrected earlier the same
> day by `bin/wiki-crosslink counts`; this pass is the re-derivation that
> correction said it did not attempt. **What changed is not detail but subject:
> the thread is a two-product channel, and the second product is cocaine.**

Vaughn (`+17245578229`, saved by Dan at least once as "cuevo") was a fellow
[[wiki/work/nemacolin-caddying|Nemacolin caddie]] who doubled as Dan's
middleman for **both weed and cocaine** across 582 messages, 73 active days and
thirteen months (2017-05-04 – 2018-05-27). He had children, no car and an
upstream source he called "my homey" and "my best friend"; he relayed product in
$20–$100 quantities between loops, could not weigh what he sold without
borrowing Dan's scale, and left for a railroad job in May 2018.

He is also the node the [[wiki/mind/synthesis/supply-network|supply network]]
page did not have. That page's succession runs
[[wiki/people/zachariah-harshman|Zach Harshman]] (2014–15) directly to
[[wiki/people/johnny-dealer|Johnny]] (2018–19) with nothing in between. This
thread opens on **2017-05-04, twenty-three days after
[[wiki/people/jay-lauer|Jay Lauer]] died of a heroin overdose** on or about
April 11, 2017, and by 20:11 that first evening Dan is asking for weed; by 20:13
he is asking for cocaine.

## Two products, one channel, and the page only ever saw one

The earlier version of this page described a "weed middleman" because weed is
what Vaughn's own half of the thread mostly discusses. Dan's half is where the
other product lives, and it is unambiguous — Vaughn himself disambiguates the
two on 2018-02-01, asking simply: **"The smoke or that girl"**.

The cocaine vocabulary in this thread is *powder*, *pow*, *that girl*, *a cut*
and — as a quality grade — *Versace*:

| Date | Line | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| 2017-05-04 | "Also I'm always looking for powder so if u come across any keep me in mind" | Sent |
| 2017-05-04 | "I'd get 100 of it tonight to try and if it's Versace i can get 300 or so tomorrow" | Sent |
| 2018-01-30 | "Can u get pow" | Sent |
| 2018-02-01 | "The smoke or that girl" | Received |
| 2018-02-03 | "Any powder?" — "Naw he left for the weekend" | Sent / Received |
| 2018-02-05 | "If you located the girl I can spend a benjj" | Sent |
| 2018-02-08 | "Pow?" — "A g" | Sent / Received |
| 2018-02-13 | "if your dude has the pow lmk" | Sent |

Corpus-wide, `pow` returns 9 rows and 8 of them are this product; `Versace`
returns 11 and is a **brand-tier metaphor for purity** Dan uses with more than
one supplier — in January 2017 he is grading a batch as *"the Versace stuff"*
against *"the Forever21 stuff"* and asking *"What's halfway between f21 and
Versace?"*. None of these words were in [[wiki/health/cocaine]]'s `aliases:`
before this pass, which is why every automated scan of this thread returned that
page's real matches as noise and its false ones ("golf balls", "blow u up") as
hits.

**"Cut" is the one term this page will not call.** It carries the cocaine sense
in some rows — *"Can I grab a cut" / "Yeah its 50 though"* (2018-02-07), the
scale-borrowing (*"Whenever you want I just need a scale"*), and the
$100/gram benchmark below — and behaves as a weed substitute in others, most
sharply on 2018-01-14, where *"Could u get me a cut this morning?"* is withdrawn
an hour later with *"I actually don't need it now. I'm grabbing some green crack
now"*, naming a cannabis strain. It is left ambiguous rather than resolved by
preference.

## The dollar figure the cocaine page says the corpus does not have

[[wiki/health/cocaine]] closes with an explicit gap: *"The true scale of the
2017–2020 spend: the dosage arc gives quantities but not dollar figures; the
financial cost of the 3.5–7g daily peak is undocumented."* On his first evening
of contact with Vaughn, pitching himself to an upstream source he had never
met, Dan wrote:

> **"Let him know that getting me as a client on that girl is like hitting the
> lottery haha. I spend well over $100 a day on it"** — 2017-05-04, 21:20

That is a contemporaneous, dated, first-person dollar rate for cocaine, and it
is the only one the corpus is currently known to hold. It comes with two
qualifications that have to travel with it, and the second is the interesting
one:

1. **It was said to make a sale happen.** The audience is a prospective
   supplier's supplier and the sentence is an advertisement for himself as a
   customer. Its slant, if it is wrong, is upward.
2. **It is at the *bottom* of the arc it falls inside, not the top.** The
   cocaine page dates the 3.5–7 g/day peak to 2017–2020. Dan enforces a
   **$100/gram** price in this same thread — *"if I'm getting it I gotta at
   least be at the 100/1 Mark"* (2018-01-23) — so "well over $100 a day" is
   a rate of roughly **one gram a day**, which is the arc's *pre-inheritance
   baseline*, in the arc's first peak year. Either the escalation had not
   started in May 2017, or the retrospective 3.5–7 g figure is inflated. The
   thread cannot decide between those and this page does not pretend to.

The largest single intent stated in the thread is **$250–275**, half a paycheck,
and that one is for weed by the zip (2018-02-01). Cocaine intents run $50, $100
("Gonna need 100", "I can spend a benjj"), and the one-off $300.

## The short-weight dispute, three times, and what it prices

The thread's signature motif is Dan weighing what he bought and finding it
light. He owned a scale from day one (*"I got a super nice scale here so we
should be good"*, 2017-05-04, 21:25); Vaughn had to borrow it.

| Date | Bought as | Weighed | Vaughn's defence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2017-05-04 | just under $50 | **0.47** | "they said they will definitely make it right for you" |
| 2017-05-30 | 3.5 g | **2.59** | "that's my best friend I got it from and I know he wouldn't do it on purpose" |
| 2018-01-23 | 1 g | **0.7** (0.9 in the bag) | "I swear I watched him weigh it" |

The first is a cocaine buy — it is the same night as the powder conversation,
and the herb is still outstanding three hours later (*"Also let me know about
that herb I'm sooooooo ready to smoke"*, 22:13). The third establishes the price
Dan considered standard: *"if I'm getting it I gotta at least be at the 100/1
Mark."* The second is weed, and its tell is elsewhere entirely — *"Mom is happy
enough with the quality that it's cool."*

The complaints are also, consistently, **de-escalated within one message**:
"Not your fault dude. It's all good", "Totally not your fault", "Not trying to
make a big deal of it either". Dan documents the shortfall to the tenth of a
gram and then absorbs it, every time, and buys again within days. At the
market's bottom tier the middleman could not verify his own product — the
quality-control vacuum the network's professional nodes
([[wiki/people/menore|Menore]], [[wiki/people/sam|Sam]]) existed to solve.

## The mother is downstream by 2018, not upstream

[[wiki/people/suzanne-frank]] records Suz as a **routine cocaine source** for
Dan in 2015–16. Two and a half years later the direction has reversed and this
thread is where it shows:

- *"Mom is happy enough with the quality that it's cool"* — 2017-05-30, on the
  2.59 g that was sold as 3.5.
- *"I'll get my mom to bring me over if u can get t now"* — 2018-02-05, his
  mother driving him to a cocaine pickup.
- *"Okay my mom wants the whole thing, do u want me to swing by In a few"* —
  2018-02-08, on a gram of powder.
- *"my moms got a lil spice, i'll roll us a jimmy john for the way up"* —
  2018-03-19, supplying the ride to work.

By the 2018 deep cycle Dan is the household's procurement function. That is a
change of role rather than a new fact about either of them, and it is written
back to her page.

## The yard: rides, checks, a grip lesson and two bottles of clean urine

The caddie half of the thread is [[wiki/timeline/periods/2017-poverty-floor|the
poverty floor]] in miniature, from both sides. Ride coordination is constant and
mutual — Vaughn has no car, Dan has one intermittently ("I won't have a ride
anywhere until midnight when my girl gets off work", "no wheels", "I don't have
a ride"). Check day is a joint operation run through the caddie master
[[wiki/people/brad-hubeaut|Brad]] ("b-rad"): *"U getting ur check today"*,
*"can you get mine? I'll message brad"*, *"Brad said ok"*. Neither man's cash
outlasts the week — *"Just a half. I get paid again on Monday so I'm just trying
to make it till then lol"*.

Three things the one-sided version could not see:

- **Vaughn taught Dan his golf grip.** *"Dude the way you changed my grip / Has
  made a REAL difference / I'm still getting things in place but my striking is
  better than it has been"* (2017-05-28). The supply relationship also ran
  instruction, in the direction the page would not have predicted.
- **The yard drug-tested, and the crew had a countermeasure.** *"i got clean
  piss in case they test early, got u covered if you need a splash"*
  (2018-03-19); *"i had jack rusko piss for me lol"*; *"i got 2 stealth bottles
  of clean pee just in case"* (2018-03-20). That names
  [[wiki/people/jack-rusko|Jack Rusko]] — an already-documented caddie with his
  own page — as the donor, and makes the evasion a three-man arrangement rather
  than a private one.
- **The friendship is real and asymmetric in Dan's favour.** He invites Vaughn
  and his girlfriend to the Halloween 2017 end-of-season and birthday party
  (*"11:1"*), offers him a *PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds* beta key, sends him
  [[wiki/interests/music/aliases/sloppp|SoundCloud.com/sloppp]] on their third
  day of contact, and returns an ASAP Ferg track Vaughn had recommended. Vaughn
  declines the party, declines the beta key, and asks for rides.

## The February 2018 sequence — barter, not a night

The earlier version of this page recorded one night: February 3, 2018, explicit
photographs of an unnamed woman, an offer to film, and a 1 AM visit three nights
later. The full thread makes it a **five-day sequence in which access is offered
as consideration for procurement**, and that is a different claim.

- **2018-02-03, 01:20–02:38** — Dan sends images; Vaughn's replies run from
  appraisal (*"Hell yeah nipples pierced and everything"*) through mock-anguish
  (*"Dan you playing wit my emotions… I thought we were friends LOL😞😞"*) to
  *"I got a nice camera let me tape lol"*. Every message in that window is
  Vaughn's; Dan sends images and two characters.
- **2018-02-05, 22:19** — mid-negotiation over a $100 cocaine buy Vaughn would
  have to deliver: *"I'll give you some videos for bringing it haha"*. Vaughn:
  *"Lol that don't help"*.
- **2018-02-06, 01:11** — during the delivery run: *"I'd let u tho… It's
  usually a pretty simple formula to get her in threesome mode"*. Vaughn:
  *"Listen you know I'm a complete gentleman / All about having fun nothing
  more / I'm here."*
- **2018-02-07, 04:15** — *"she's the only girl I've ever let loose like that.
  She's like…not smart enough to have tricks up her sleeve or lie / I can enjoy
  the taboo of sharing her and know that she's not about to catch feels"*.
- **2018-02-07, 18:18** — the barter stated outright: *"You're going to want to
  get powder / Because tomorrow or Friday if you can hook it up she said she
  would blow you / You're welcome forever"*.

The next night Dan adds *"Play it cool about what I mentioned earlier… I
wouldn't overdo it if you do say something"* (2018-02-08, 02:28) — a
consciousness that the offer was his to walk back. The thread records no
outcome. **The woman is never named in it**, and this page does not attempt an
identification; the appraisal of her intelligence and her incapacity to "catch
feels" is the load-bearing part of the quote for
[[wiki/mind/psychosexual/orchestration-and-voyeurism]] whoever she was.

## Corpus record

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Messages | **582** — 354 sent (Dan), 228 received |
| Active days | 73 across 13 months |
| Date range | 2017-05-04 – 2018-05-27 |
| Products | Cannabis (flower, oil carts) **and cocaine** |
| Price benchmark | $100/gram, enforced by weight |
| Quantities | $20–$100 typical; $250–275 stated once (weed, by the zip) |
| Exit | Railroad job starting ~2018-05-16 |

**The thread's shape is seasonal and then it is not.** 156 messages in May
2017, then **23 across the next seven months**, then 146 in January 2018, 178
in February and 58 in March — 382 messages in eleven weeks. The dead stretch is
the 2017 caddie season, when both men were working; the 2018 spike is the
[[wiki/timeline/periods/2018-deep-cycle|deep cycle]], and it stops as abruptly
as it started.

**Gaps:** surname, and which yard crew he belonged to. The identity of the
"homey"/"best friend" upstream source — the person the $100/day pitch was
actually aimed at — who is never named and who this page cannot connect to any
other node. The February 2018 woman and whether anything occurred. Whether the
railroad job took: the thread ends twelve days after he announces it, with
*"Yo do you know anyone wit a ride that wants to make sum money"* (2018-05-27),
and he never reappears in the corpus. And the "cut" ambiguity above, which one
more corroborated price or a scale reading would settle.
